title: Untitled Duck Mod x Pets Mod
description: The ducks and geese from Untitled Duck Mod as pets in Pets Mod!
body:
Ever wanted the ducks and geese from Untitled Duck Mod to follow you no matter where you go, including servers? Thanks to Pets Mod, this (unofficial) addon lets you have that oppurtunity! Everything is client-sided so you can even have them on servers like Hypixel.

To summon your pet, do /petspecies untitled and choose either untitled duck or untitled goose from the list. To change the skin of your pet, do /petskin and choose what you want from the list.

All assets belong to the Untitled Duck Mod team
Special thanks to the creator of Pet Mod for helping me get this to work :]
